walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: My Personal World — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: My Personal World brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: My Personal World.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: In which year did Algeria gain independence from France?
Which is NOT part of the Maghreb?
options: Algérie
Maroc
Tunisie
Sénégal

mcqs.q: How do you describe weather in the past, e.g. 'it was sunny'?
options: Passé composé - 'Il a fait beau' (which suggests a completed event).
Imperfect - 'Il faisait beau' (descriptive past state).
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
When you don't know what tense to use.

mcqs.q: When do you use the imperfect rather than the passé composé?
options: For ongoing, habitual, or descriptive past actions.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
Just for older events.
When you don't know what tense to use.
Annually.
Actually (in reality).
Currently/at the moment.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
